frozen_protocol.reset: original JSON once per session; set-current, land, charge before each task
frozen_protocol.timeout_source: upstream Checker GUI timeout_var initial value (500), not AGENT_TIMEOUT fallback (300)
frozen_protocol.timeout_policy: close admission, drain, freeze world, score; continue only after worker exits; no retry
frozen_protocol.inflight_policy: finish requests admitted before cutoff; refuse later and stale-lease requests
frozen_protocol.grading_state: pause simulation ticks after drain; resume before next preparation
frozen_protocol.agent_budget: upstream max_iterations=150; recursion_limit=450; not a hard tool budget

deepseek.scene_order: claim in frozen plan order; finish independently
deepseek.recovery: reuse sealed scenes; replay whole incomplete scenes only

qwen.scene_order: claim in frozen plan order; finish independently
qwen.recovery: reuse sealed scenes; replay whole incomplete scenes only

policy.main_selection: Every scene generation 1; no task splicing, no best-of selection
policy.missing: Any unscored task downstream of documented worker/continuation interruption contributes zero checks and fails
policy.provider: Terminal failed model API jobs contribute zero checks and fail in first-attempt deployment
policy.observed: Preserve saved checker scores for world-quiescent tasks, even if worker did not exit
policy.deployment_pass: Task check passed AND worker exit confirmed AND no terminal provider failure
policy.qwen_closure: Use fixed pre-generation-4 snapshot, no outcomes from manually stopped generation 4
policy.cost: All executed generations, including discarded and manually stopped replay, remain in actual observed usage
